# Site2Chat

> Turn any website into an AI chatbot in 2 minutes.

Site2Chat is a fast, lightweight platform that automatically crawls and reads your public website pages, converts them into a searchable vector knowledge base, and deploys an interactive AI chatbot that answers visitor questions with verified citations from your site.

## Key Features

- **Automated Web Ingestion**: Provide any website URL; Site2Chat crawls up to 100 pages, extracts clean content, chunks the text, and computes high-dimensional embeddings.
- **Flexible AI Models**: Supports ultra-fast inference via Groq (Llama 3.3 70B Versatile) and multi-model access through OpenRouter with Bring-Your-Own-Key (BYOK) support.
- **Accurate RAG Retrieval**: Answers are strictly grounded in your site's ingested content to prevent hallucinations and provide exact answers.
- **Easy Sharing & Embedding**: Instant standalone public chat link, plus a lightweight one-line `<script>` tag to embed a customized floating chat widget on any CMS or site builder.
- **Privacy & Security**: Secure Supabase authentication, encrypted provider API keys, and isolated chatbot data.
